functions.name: SpirvBuiltinToString
functions.docs: Returns the string representation of the specified SPIR-V built-in variable, e.g. SpvBuiltInPosition to TEXT("gl_Position"). Returns nullptr for invalid value.

functions.name: FindOffsetToSpirvEntryPoint
functions.signature: FindOffsetToSpirvEntryPoint(Spirv, Entry Point Name, Out Word Offset To Entry Point, Out Word Offset To Main Name)

params.name: Out Word Offset To Entry Point
Out Word Offset To Main Name

functions.docs: Returns word offset to the entry point (OpEntryPoint) and name of the entry point (OpName). If the respective entry has not been found, the output offset is 0.

functions.name: FindSpirvEntryPoint
functions.docs: Finds the entry point name name.

functions.name: PatchSpirvEntryPointWithCRC
functions.docs: Renames the fixed-size entry point name (which must be "main_00000000_00000000") to the formatted name including a CRC over the module. Returns the new entry point name.

functions.name: ParseSpirvGlobalVariables
functions.signature: ParseSpirvGlobalVariables(Spirv, Storage Class, Out Variable Names)
functions.docs: Parse global variables (anything but function local variables) of specified storage class from the specified SPIR-V module.
